title: Lesson 10. Mini project — a landing page
description: Building a page from scratch: flex, grid, semantics and responsiveness

learn.intro: Hi! Lesson 10 — a **mini project**. We'll build a full landing page from everything we know. Let's go!

slides.text: Today we build a full page from scratch. We use everything: box model, flexbox, grid and responsive design.

The landing layout:
— a header with a menu
— a hero block with a heading and a button
— 3 advantages
— cards or reviews
— a footer
We build **block by block**, not the whole page at once.

check.prompt: It is better to build a landing page block by block.
check.explain: This way it is easier not to get lost and to check the result.

check.prompt: Which of these is NOT part of the lesson's landing layout?
check.explain: A database is not page layout.

slides.text: Before each block ask yourself: which tool is needed here — **flex** or **grid**?

`flex` — elements in one row or column, alignment (for example, the menu in the header).
`grid` — a grid of rows and columns, cards in several rows.
First we choose the tool, then we write the code.

check.prompt: What is better for a grid of cards in several rows?
check.explain: grid is a grid of rows and columns.

check.prompt: What is better for a one-row menu in the header?
check.explain: flex — elements in one row and alignment.

slides.text:
`gap` — the space between elements, no extra margins.
Semantic tags: `<header>`, `<section>`, `<footer>` instead of faceless `<div>`.

check.prompt: Which tag is better for the page footer?
gap sets the space between elements in flex and grid.
check.explain: So no extra margins are needed.

pairs: A grid of cards in several rows

questions.prompt: What is better for a row of 3 advantages?
questions.explain: Both flex and grid fit a row.

questions.prompt: Which tag is better for the site header?
questions.explain: <header> is the semantic header tag. <head> is something else entirely.

questions.prompt: Which tag replaces a faceless <div> for the footer?
questions.explain: footer is the semantic footer tag.

gap lets you avoid extra margins between elements.
